ledger.point: Children predominantly ischaemic; adult presentations variable including haemorrhage; fragile collaterals/aneurysms as bleeding sources

ledger.point: Hyperventilation/hypocapnia can disturb perfusion in impaired reserve with complex regional responses/steal

ledger.note: Not every stenosed territory is asserted to constrict uniformly; new/persistent symptoms require acute evaluation.
